notes: Dev.21 adds bounded probe facts, deterministic Copy/Remux/Transcode planning, explicit mode execution and strict post-probe target validation without widening executable or raw-argument trust surfaces.
Copy is managed byte-exact copy with SHA-256 equality and launches no FFmpeg; Remux/Transcode use provider-owned fixed token tuples only.
Actual packaged ffprobe/ffmpeg descendants are qualified inside strict worker Job/AppContainer containment with filesystem/network/orphan canaries.
Audio 36-case, Image 24-case and Video 27-case acceptance/negative/mixed-batch regression gates remain mandatory.
Headed Win11 acceptance, live repository governance, production signing/B2, production FFmpeg redistribution, signed MSIX lifecycle and final release audit remain open.
